visual.name: bfusionResourceConstraintSequencing
visual.description: Ranked project bars (per scenario) over a monthly committed-effort demand curve with a max-capacity reference line. Drives go/no-go sequencing decisions against the resource ceiling.

dataRoles.name: project
dataRoles.description: Project / plan name. Bind Plan_Projects[Name].

dataRoles.name: projectId
dataRoles.description: Stable id used for selection. Bind Plan_Projects[Id].

dataRoles.name: scenario
dataRoles.description: Modeler scenario. Bind ModelerScenario[Name].

dataRoles.name: inScenario
dataRoles.description: 1 = project is in selected scenario, 0 = candidate. Bind [Modeler | Membership 1] or ModelerScenarioPlan[Checked].

dataRoles.name: priority
dataRoles.description: Project ranking score (higher = first). Bind [Modeler | Priority Score].

dataRoles.name: committedEffort
dataRoles.description: Bind [Committed Effort] or Plan_Projects[CommittedEffort].

dataRoles.name: projectStart
dataRoles.description: Bind Plan_Projects[EstimatedStart].

dataRoles.name: projectEnd
dataRoles.description: Bind Plan_Projects[EstimatedEnd].

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Month/period date for the lower demand curve. Bind Calendar[Date] or Calendar[Period].

dataRoles.name: periodDemand
dataRoles.description: Per-period committed demand. Bind [Committed] or SUM(ResPlan[Hours]) filtered to Committed.

dataRoles.name: periodCapacity
dataRoles.description: Per-period available capacity. Bind [Capacity] or SUM(Capacity[Capacity]).

dataRoles.name: hoursPerFte
dataRoles.description: Divisor for hours → FTE conversion. Bind [Capacity per FTE] or leave blank to use the Format-pane default.

dataRoles.name: compareInScenario
dataRoles.description: Membership flag for the comparison scenario. Bind a DAX measure like CALCULATE([Modeler | Membership 1], ModelerScenario[Name]="<Baseline>").

dataRoles.name: compareCommittedEffort
dataRoles.description: Committed Effort hours for the comparison scenario.

dataRoles.name: compareDemand
dataRoles.description: Period demand for the comparison scenario. Bind CALCULATE([Committed], ModelerScenario[Name]="<Baseline>").

dataRoles.name: currentBudget
dataRoles.description: Per-project budget in current scenario. Drives Δ Budget tile and tooltip.

dataRoles.name: compareBudget
dataRoles.description: Per-project budget in comparison scenario.

dataRoles.name: currentBenefits
dataRoles.description: Per-project benefits in current scenario. Drives Δ Benefits and Δ ROI tiles.

dataRoles.name: compareBenefits
dataRoles.description: Per-project benefits in comparison scenario.

dataRoles.name: alignmentScore
dataRoles.description: 0-100 alignment score per project. Bind [Modeler | Strategic Alignment Score]. Powers alignment delta and tooltip row.

dataRoles.name: riskScore
dataRoles.description: 0-100 risk score per project (higher = riskier). Tints bar stroke; powers risk delta.

dataRoles.name: confidenceLow
dataRoles.description: Optional lower-bound demand per period. Renders as light envelope band.

dataRoles.name: confidenceHigh
dataRoles.description: Optional upper-bound demand per period. Renders as light envelope band.

dataRoles.name: resourceRole
dataRoles.description: Optional grouping for sub-bar split. Bind ResPlan[Role_Value] or Resources[Role_Value].

dataRoles.name: projectSparkline
dataRoles.description: Optional per-project per-period FTE/hours measure for mini sparkline next to each project label.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
